summary_en: OKM authorized acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (6.86% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥500 million through market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 24, 2026 to November 19, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Resolution Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Okumura Engineering's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 300,000 ordinary shares, representing 6.86% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum expenditure of ¥500 million. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading arrangement, with the purchase period running from November 24, 2026 to November 19, 2027.

The company stated that the purpose of the share buyback is to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation. The authorization was made in accordance with Article 459, paragraph 1 of the Companies Act and Article 40 of the company's articles of incorporation.
